investment_theses.thesis: Long Bitcoin against USD into Q3 2026 as Fed rate-cut cycle begins, inflation remains sticky enough to prevent aggressive cuts, and institutional FOMO from Anthropic IPO/Trump admin crypto clarity flows into digital gold.
supporting_signals: Fed minutes confirm rate hikes still expected but 'close call'; sticky inflation keeps real rates positive, supporting BTC as insurance hedge.
MARA debt refinance and $1B BTC sale suggest miner distress bottoming; historically precedes BTC recovery.
Trump admin anti-scam center and Kash Patel activity signal pro-crypto regulatory posture (despite Mar-a-Lago gala optics).
Anthropic IPO retail enthusiasm likely spills into crypto; retail trader FOMO is macro tailwind into summer doldrums.
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed stays hawkish into Q3 if June/July PCE remains >2.5%; geopolitical escalation (Ukraine tunnel fighting, Gaza) could trigger risk-off and BTC drawdown. AI capex inflation could force Fed to hike further than expected.
investment_theses.expression: BTC/USD perps on Deribit or Bybit, 100x leverage (or spot BTC + call options for lower-risk variant). Target: BTC crosses $95k by Sept 30, 2026. Hedge: short SPY or long VIX calls if rate-cut expectations evaporate.

investment_theses.thesis: Long NVDA stock and short AI-infrastructure debt (via credit default swaps or shorting CoreWeave equity if public) on view that Huang's departure clears board room for cost discipline; AI-capex cycle is peaking.
supporting_signals: Interim CEO Colette Kress framing as 'move forward' and offering pay raises signals continuity but also implies cost-cutting elsewhere; non-core headcount reduction likely.
CoreWeave debt concerns and $1.5B startup challenging Hyperliquid with Wall Street playbook suggest AI-infrastructure margin compression into H2 2026.
Palo Alto $4.5B Applied Compute M&A validates cyber tooling (not raw compute) as higher-margin end market.
Fed tightness and rate expectations mean AI leverage will face margin calls; NVDA's balance sheet and pricing power insulate it vs. pure-play cloud.
investment_theses.counter_view: NVDA's data-center segment remains growth engine; Huang's exit may cause key talent defection or strategic stumble. CoreWeave distress is priced in and AI capex continues strong into 2027.
investment_theses.expression: Long NVDA stock (call options Oct-Dec 2026 $160 strike); short CDS on CoreWeave if available on credit markets, or synthetically via short small-cap AI infra ETF (if exists). Hedge: long QQQ if broad tech rotation concerns arise.

investment_theses.thesis: Long US Dollar (DXY) and short Ethereum into Q2/Q3 2026 if Fed rate expectations for more hikes solidify in May/June data; sticky inflation keeps real rates positive and crowns USD as carry unwind headwind for crypto.
supporting_signals: Fed minutes confirm 'more rate hikes' expected; October hold was 'close call,' implying June/July hikes still live if inflation cooperates.
AI capex driving upstream inflation (energy, chips, cloud services); deflationary narrative is premature.
Tether/USDT reserve scrutiny (S&P criticism cited in Cointelegraph) suggests stablecoin basis risk if DXY rallies sharply.
Kalshi legal headwinds and crypto derivative uncertainty push institutional capital to dollar-denominated assets; USD outflows slow.
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed cuts rates sooner than expected (June PCE surprise lower); geopolitical risk (Ukraine escalation) triggers safe-haven crypto demand. USDC yield and yield-generating stablecoins attract institutional carry.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY index (or long USD/EUR via FX forwards); short ETH/USD via spot or perps. Position size: moderate (2-3% account risk). Stop: reverse if PCE < 2.3% in June or geopolitical tail-risk event surfaces.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Palo Alto Networks (PANW) stock on view that AI-cybersecurity M&A wave is structural; $4.5B Applied Compute deal sets floor for valuation multiple re-rating, and enterprise AI-security spend accelerates into 2026-27.
supporting_signals: 7% stock pop on $4.5B Applied Compute deal suggests market underestimating M&A synergy and enterprise AI-defense TAM.
CrowdStrike, Fortinet, and other cyber names trading at elevated multiples; PANW is comparatively undervalued on FY27E earnings if Applied Compute closes and integrates smoothly.
Hong Kong AI-crypto crime-detection mandate (CoinDesk/Cointelegraph) validates enterprise demand for AI tooling; regulatory tailwind for established players like PANW.
investment_theses.counter_view: Applied Compute integration risks; valuation multiple compression if tech growth slows. Cyber M&A multiples are unsustainable and face repricing.
investment_theses.expression: Long PANW calls (Jun 2026 $150 strike, roll to Sep if profitable). Buy and hold common stock if patient capital; target Sept 30 close >$150. Hedge: position sizing at 2-3% of portfolio; stop at $130.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Hyperliquid (HYPE) and decentralized-exchange tokens on view that Kalshi regulatory headwinds create vacuum for decentralized alternatives; Wall Street's $1.5B startup challenger validates institutional demand for derivatives beyond traditional venues.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk reports $1.5B startup taking on Hyperliquid with Wall Street playbook; institutional derivatives demand is live and constrained by Kalshi legal battles.
Hyperliquid tops crypto trending; Backpack (BP) and Canton (CC) trending alongside suggest alt-venue capital rotation.
Anthropic IPO retail fomo likely spills into crypto derivative trading on decentralized venues.
Kraken (Payward) CEO's venture fund (Tribe) buyback signals internal capital redeployment; crypto exchange infrastructure M&A tailwind.
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory crackdown on decentralized derivatives (similar to Kalshi) could hit Hyperliquid valuations. Market manipulation and custody risks underappreciated by retail fomo buyers.
investment_theses.expression: Long HYPE token (spot or perps). Position size: 1-2% of crypto portfolio (high-risk/high-reward). Buy dips to $10-12 USD; target $20+ by Aug 2026. Hedge: take profits at 50% and re-establish on further dips; stop at $8 if thesis breaks.
